description: İstanbul Solar Enerji Potansiyeli Haritası is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Information Technologies. Solar haritalar genel olarak, belirli bir arazi parçasının, binanın veya evin belirli bir miktarda güneş ışığını ne kadar deneyimlediğine ilişkin bilgileri gösteren bir şehir, eyalet, ülke veya herhangi bir kara parçasının haritasıdır. Coverage: Department of Information Technologies. The publisher named on the listing is Department of Information Technologies. Its keywords include diffuse, enerji haritası, harita, renkli harita, siyah beyaz harita, solar. The listing shows 5 download or service links in PDF, OGC WMS. The listing shows 2023-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
